app_tagline: Design, build and test your adventures in one place.
cli_usage:
Usage: aide [options]

Start the AIDE web application.

Options:
  -H, --host <address>  Address to listen on (default: {host}, env: HOST)
  -p, --port <number>   Port to listen on (default: {port}, env: PORT)
  -v, --version         Print the version and exit
  -h, --help            Print this help and exit
cli_invalid_port: Invalid port "{value}": expected a whole number from 0 to 65535.
